arts.ttl: Daniel Farke says Leeds must handle ‘outside noise’ ahead of Man City trip
arts.sum: Daniel Farke presented a composed and purposeful message as Leeds United continued preparations for their trip to Manchester City. “We just need players who stick to our structure” he said.

arts.sum: Erling Haaland will fancy his chances of plundering more Manchester City goals against Leeds this weekend but the Premier League strugglers will always be in the Norwegian's heart

arts.ttl: Man City v Leeds: Pre Match Analysis
arts.sum: United have slipped into the relegation zone and it is hard to see at this current moment with the fixtures they have coming up, how they will climb above that red line any time soon. Sitting in third, six points from leaders Arsenal and coming off the back of back to back defeats for the second time this season, after a Champions League reverse in midweek followed an away defeat at Newcastle.

arts.ttl: Manchester City vs Leeds United: Premier League Preview, Gameweek 14, 2025
arts.sum: A must-win fixture awaits Pep Guardiola’s Manchester City as they welcome a struggling Leeds United side to the Etihad on Saturday afternoon. Gianluigi Donnarumma is set to replace James Trafford in goal, while Erling Haaland — born in Leeds — will return to lead the line.
